title: Identity
description: A minted, globally unique name for a code entity. Produced only by awl.ids, the single normalization authority: two producers that disagree here split one entity into disconnected nodes.

iri.description: The canonical IRI. The only field consumers should compare.

scheme.description: Language or frontend dimension, e.g. py.

symbol.description: Dotted path within the module, e.g. ChargeParam.charge.

version.description: Set for OO-LD classes; null when unknown. Never guessed.

disambiguator.description: Distinguishes overloads and typed instantiations of a generic callee.

alias_of.description: The alias hop, if this identity was reached through one.

alias_root.description: The resolved-to-root target, so queries choose their indirection level.

declared_types.description: IRIs or CURIEs a class declares for its instances, from x-oold-instance-rdf-type or the inline type field default. A list, because it co-types. Carried alongside iri and never instead of it: a declared type is usually a CURIE against a prefix this package does not control, so using it as the identity mints predicates that join with nothing.
